title: Exact Hyperbolic-Tangent Belief Propagation LLR Algebra on Noisy CNOT Parity Checks
claims: A weight-2 noisy parity check c = z_0 (+) z_l with measurement bias gamma_check and partner prior bias gamma_partner contributes exact extrinsic LLR 2 * atanh(gamma_check * gamma_partner) to z_0.
Across L disjoint auxiliary checks on a star tree, additive BP LLR pooling matches exact 2^L marginal Bayes inference to < 1e-12 and monotonically reduces MAP bit error probability.
favorable_controls: L = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 auxiliary checks at gamma_0 = 0.5, gamma_partner = gamma_check = 0.7
